soundness_flags.one_line: The estimator and covariance estimator are K-vectors, whereas ΣB and ΣCR are defined only on A; moreover CR assumes positive shares only on A while claiming a full-U limit, so restrict these CLTs to A or define full-K covariances and require all reported shares positive.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Core exact-hit and mechanism theorems
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Claims are conditional on fixed n and K, equal cluster sizes, interior rational saturations, isolated iid cluster schedules, and the exact-slice welfare target.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The field-level mechanism and efficiency claims are evaluated only within this explicitly restricted randomized-saturation regime.
